channels.description: Cyprus IT job postings — companies and recruiters post open roles
channels.message_format: Structured job ads, 15-30 lines. Role title, company, requirements, tech stack, how to apply. Hashtags at top.
channels.desired_roles: ML research scientist, computational neuroscience, probabilistic ML, cognitive systems
channels.acceptable_roles: Data scientist, ML engineer, research engineer, AI engineer, backend Python
channels.flash_prompt:
You are a job posting filter. Examine the following first lines of a posting from a tech-jobs Telegram group.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text: {"is_vacancy": true/false, "flag": true/false, "reason": "one sentence"}

is_vacancy: true if this is a job offer; false if someone is seeking work, posting their CV, or it's off-topic.
flag: true if the role involves Python, ML, AI, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, data science, backend engineering, research engineering, or similar.
flag must be false if is_vacancy is false.

channels.description: Cyprus HR and recruitment channel — recruiters and companies post openings
channels.message_format: Single-line or very short posts with hashtags. No structure, limited detail.
channels.desired_roles: ML research, computational neuroscience, cognitive systems
channels.acceptable_roles: Data science, ML engineering, research positions, technical roles in Cyprus
channels.flash_prompt:
You are a job posting filter reading one line at a time.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"decision": "irrelevant" | "relevant" | "next", "reason": "one sentence"}

- irrelevant: clearly not a job vacancy relevant to the candidate — stop here
- relevant: looks like a relevant vacancy — escalate to full evaluation
- next: cannot decide yet — read the next line
